name: coder
description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
one_liner: Gives every developer (and every AI coding agent) their own ready-to-code computer in the cloud that spins up in seconds and shuts down automatically when idle.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company who wants to onboard new hires in minutes instead of days and control which AI models touch company code.
business_use_cases: A company with strict security requirements self-hosts it so AI coding agents run on company infrastructure with no API keys ever touching developer laptops.
A dev-heavy company shortens new-hire onboarding from days to minutes by giving every engineer a pre-configured cloud workspace on day one.
A platform team cuts cloud spend by auto-shutting down idle developer environments instead of paying for always-on VMs.

money_ideas.idea: Sell managed hosting and setup of Coder for mid-size engineering teams that don't want to run it themselves.
Offer a fixed-price 'migrate your dev team to cloud workspaces' consulting engagement.

steal_this: Package a 'set up your team's AI-agent-ready dev environments in a day' consulting offer for companies still using laptops for everything.
